name: IsPolar.exists_window_sub_mul_le
summary: If E − XE′ > e^(−t) on the whole window [t, t²], the k-th moment with k ≈ t²/9, corrected by two exponentials that dominate outside the window, would be ≥ 0; but the moment bounds make it negative.

steps.claim: The moment bounds of `IsPolar.eventually_moment_le` hold for E and for E′ for all R > 3 close to 3; take one such R with 3 < R < 4 (p, q), with the moment bounds c (for E) and d (for E′), each eventually in t.
steps.lean:
(h.eventually_moment_le.and
  (h'.eventually_moment_le.and (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (lt_add_one _)))).exists.elim fun R ⟨c, d, p, q⟩ ↦ by

steps.claim: Restate the bounds with two-sided inequalities: −t·e^v ≤ E(v) ≤ t·e^v, and −k!t/R^k ≤ ∫ F_k ≤ k!t/R^k.
Take t large: the bounds for E (c: pointwise, a: moments) and for E′ (d, b) hold at t, t ≥ 99/(log R − log 3) (u) and t ≥ 9; fix X with 0 ≤ X ≤ e^t.
steps.lean:
filter_upwards [c, d, mem_atTop (99 / (R.log - .log 3)), mem_atTop 9]
    with t ⟨c, _, a⟩ ⟨d, _, b⟩ u _ X ⟨_, _⟩

steps.claim: Record: 0 < R (w); for every R′ > 0, ∫_0^∞ v^k e^(−R′v) dv = k!/R′^(k+1) (I, `laplace_pow`); and t + tX + 1 ≤ e^t·e^t (K, from t + 1 ≤ e^t and X ≤ e^t).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨w, I, K : t + t * X + 1 ≤ t.exp * t.exp⟩ := three_pos.trans p,
    mod_cast fun R : ℝ ↦ (@laplace_pow R · k), by nlinarith [t.add_one_le_exp]

steps.claim: J: for R′ > 0, v ↦ v^k e^(−R′v) is integrable on (0, ∞) (its integral k!/R′^(k+1) is not 0).
steps.lean: have J R o := Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero ((I R o).trans_ne (by simp; grind))

steps.claim: Suppose the contrary (N): E(u) − X·E′(u) > e^(−t) for every u ∈ [t, t²].

0 ≤ ∫_0^∞ v^k·(e^(−Rv)e^(7t) + e^(−v)e^(2t − t²) + e^(−3v)(E(v) − X·E′(v) − e^(−t))) dv: the integrand is ≥ 0 at every v > 0; for v ∈ [t, t²] by N; for v outside the window by the hole proved in step 10.
steps.lean:
have : 0 ≤ ∫ v in Ioi 0, v ^ k * ((-R * v).exp * (7 * t).exp + (-1 * v).exp *
    (2 * t - t ^ 2).exp + (-3 * v).exp * (E v - _ * X - (-t).exp)) := setIntegral_nonneg
    (by simp) fun v (l : 0 < v) ↦ mul_nonneg (by bound) (by_cases (by bound [N v ·]) fun x ↦ ?_)
steps.typed_fact:
0 ≤ ∫ v in Ioi 0, v ^ k * ((-R * v).exp * (7 * t).exp + (-1 * v).exp *
    (2 * t - t ^ 2).exp + (-3 * v).exp * (E v - _ * X - (-t).exp))

steps.claim: But this integral is negative, a contradiction.
steps.lean:
· simp (disch := first | fun_prop (disch := simp [w]) | simp [*]) [mul_add, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
      integral_add, integral_sub, I, -neg_mul] at this
    grw [a.2, ← b.1, (by ring : _ - _ * X = k ! * (t + t * X) / R ^ k), lt_add_one (t + _), K,
      add_sub, sub_pos] at this
    apply this.not_ge ((add_le_add_three ..).trans_eq (add_thirds _)) <;>
    simp (disch := positivity) [← log_le_log_iff] <;> nlinarith [log_three_lt_d9,
      abs_le.1 (abs_sub_ceil_le (by bound : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 / 9)), (div_le_iff₀ (by bound)).1 u]

steps.claim: Split the integral: it equals k!e^(7t)/R^(k+1) + k!e^(2t − t²) + ∫v^k e^(−3v)E − X·∫v^k e^(−3v)E′ − e^(−t)·k!/3^(k+1) (I, with the integrability of steps 6 and 3).
steps.lean:
· simp (disch := first | fun_prop (disch := simp [w]) | simp [*]) [mul_add, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
      integral_add, integral_sub, I, -neg_mul] at this

steps.claim: Bound the moments: ∫v^k e^(−3v)E ≤ k!t/R^k (a), −X·∫v^k e^(−3v)E′ ≤ X·k!t/R^k (b), so the two moment terms are at most k!(t + tX)/R^k < k!(t + tX + 1)/R^k ≤ k!e^(2t)/R^k (K); the integral being ≥ 0 then gives e^(−t)k!/3^(k+1) < k!e^(7t)/R^(k+1) + k!e^(2t − t²) + k!e^(2t)/R^k.
steps.lean:
grw [a.2, ← b.1, (by ring : _ - _ * X = k ! * (t + t * X) / R ^ k), lt_add_one (t + _), K,
      add_sub, sub_pos] at this

steps.claim: Each of the three terms on the right is at most a third of the left side, so their sum is at most the left side: a contradiction. In logarithms this is linear arithmetic, using log 3 < 1.0987, |k − t²/9| ≤ 1 and t·(log R − log 3) ≥ 99 (u): e.g. (3/R)^k ≤ e^(−k log(R/3)) ≤ e^(−11t).
steps.lean:
apply this.not_ge ((add_le_add_three ..).trans_eq (add_thirds _)) <;>
    simp (disch := positivity) [← log_le_log_iff] <;> nlinarith [log_three_lt_d9,
      abs_le.1 (abs_sub_ceil_le (by bound : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 / 9)), (div_le_iff₀ (by bound)).1 u]

steps.claim: The hole of step 8: for v > 0 outside [t, t²], the bracket is ≥ 0.
steps.lean:
grw [← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg, ← c.1, d.2, (by grind : -t ≤ v), (by ring : -_ = (-3 * v).exp *
    v.exp * (t + t * X + 1)), K, ← max_le_add_of_nonneg] <;> simp [← Real.exp_add, exp_nonneg, l.le]
  contrapose! x; use ?_ <;> nlinarith

steps.claim: |E(v) − X·E′(v) − e^(−t)|·e^(−3v) ≤ e^(−3v)·e^v·(t + tX + 1) ≤ e^(−2v)·e^(2t) (c, d, K); so it suffices that e^(2t − 2v) ≤ max(e^(7t − Rv), e^(2t − t² − v)) ≤ their sum.
steps.lean:
grw [← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg, ← c.1, d.2, (by grind : -t ≤ v), (by ring : -_ = (-3 * v).exp *
    v.exp * (t + t * X + 1)), K, ← max_le_add_of_nonneg] <;> simp [← Real.exp_add, exp_nonneg, l.le]

steps.claim: If v < t then 7t − Rv ≥ 2t − 2v (as R < 4 and v < t); if v > t² then 2t − t² − v ≥ 2t − 2v; this is linear arithmetic once v ∉ [t, t²] is split into these two cases.
